cohort: 155 cases of gastroschisis referred to and delivering at the Mater Mothers' Hospital in Brisbane, Australia over a 16-year period
finding: Extra-abdominal bowel dilatation was the only risk factor for intrapartum fetal compromise necessitating emergency delivery.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery (Cesarean section) was higher in pregnancies complicated by extra-abdominal bowel dilatation.
